about_the_game:
NAD is a roguelike tower defense game where you forge your own path through the underground world, collect resources, and build towers to fend off swarming enemies.

Explore, survive, and battle bosses! Experience excitement and tension through dynamic, ever-changing gameplay.

📖 Story

In the magical land of Carden, the village once thrived on the energy of magical stones.
One day, a sudden explosion throws the village into chaos.
In desperation, the archmage attempts to summon a legendary miner to stop the disaster—
but ends up calling a modern-day protagonist who was about to be hit by a truck!

To return home, the protagonist must pick up a pickaxe and descend deep underground.
Will he survive and find his way back to his world?

🌕 Explore by Day, Defend by Night, and Face Bosses!

During the day, venture into the ever-shifting underground using your pickaxe.
Mine resources and carve out unique paths through randomly generated terrains and ruins.

But once night falls, the tides turn.
Enemies follow the routes you created and launch their assault.
Build towers and use your skills to stop the enemy waves!

In the depths, powerful bosses await.
Each boss has unique abilities and patterns—use special weapons to defeat them and move forward.

🏘️ Recover and Grow in the Village

If you fall during battle, return to the village to regroup.
Upgrade gear at the shop, enhance skills and towers at the lab, and prepare for your next expedition.
Death is not the end—it’s an opportunity for growth!

🧩 Key Features

🌑 1. Underground Exploration & Resource Gathering
Explore a procedurally generated world full of ores, traps, and ruins.
Strategically dig routes and collect resources for nighttime defense.

🛡️ 2. Nighttime Defense Battles
Enemies attack following the paths you carved.
Build towers and defend using your resources and skills.

👑 3. Epic Boss Battles
Powerful bosses with unique mechanics await deep underground.
Defeat them with special weapons to advance to the next area.

🏘️ 4. Growth and Retry from the Village
Return to the village after each run with gold earned from battle.
Grow stronger through upgrades and challenge again!

🌀 Dive into the world of NAD now!
With ever-changing exploration, unpredictable enemies, and thrilling boss fights,
NAD delivers a strategic, survival-driven roguelike tower defense experience full of challenge and reward.
